title: Gapped text: the risky migration
instructions: Cinco oraciones fueron eliminadas del texto. Elegí de la lista (A-H) la que encaja en cada hueco. Hay TRES oraciones que sobran.
text: Marta manages a small team of developers. Last month, the company asked her team to move all its data to a new cloud provider. [1] If everything goes well, the change will save a lot of money. However, the process is risky. Two years ago, a similar project failed because the tests had not been completed. [2] Marta says that if they had planned it better, they would have avoided those problems. This time, she wants to be careful. [3] The team will not start the migration unless every test passes. [4] As a result, the launch has been postponed by two weeks. Some managers are unhappy about it. Personally, Marta believes it is the right decision. [5] She wishes the company had listened to her advice earlier.
bank: The company hopes to finish the work by the end of the year.
It was a very expensive mistake.
She has asked the directors for more time and more tests.
The first results, however, have not been good enough.
A failed launch would be much more expensive than a delay.
Marta studied law before becoming a manager.
The migration finished yesterday without any problems.
Next year the company will open offices in three new countries.

a: The company hopes to finish the work by the end of the year.
items.e: Introduce el plan; 'the change' en la oración siguiente se refiere a la migración.

a: It was a very expensive mistake.
items.e: Comenta el proyecto fallido; Marta lo retoma con un condicional.

a: She has asked the directors for more time and more tests.
items.e: Muestra cómo Marta 'wants to be careful' antes de la regla del equipo.

a: The first results, however, have not been good enough.
items.e: Es la causa; 'As a result' introduce la consecuencia (el retraso).

a: A failed launch would be much more expensive than a delay.

title: Post-mortem: the lost orders
instructions: Leé el texto y elegí la respuesta correcta para cada pregunta.
text:
Last Friday, the payments system stopped working for three hours. According to the report, the cause was a mistake made by a junior developer, Iván. He had run a script on the production database instead of the test database. If he had checked the server name, he would have noticed the problem immediately.
The team reacted quickly. As soon as they saw the error, they restored a backup. Unfortunately, the backup was two days old, so some customers lost their last orders. If the team had kept more recent copies, the loss would have been much smaller. Therefore, the company has decided to make backups every hour.
Iván feels terrible. "I wish I had read the screen more carefully," he says. "If only I had asked a colleague to review the script first!" His manager, however, does not blame him. "Anyone could have done the same," she says. "We will only improve if we learn from our mistakes. From now on, no one will touch the production database unless a second person approves the change."

o: A script run on the wrong database
items.a: A script run on the wrong database
items.e: 'run a script on the production database instead of the test database'.

items.q: How old was the backup the team restored?
items.e: 'the backup was two days old'.

items.q: Why did some customers lose orders?
items.e: 'the backup was two days old, so some customers lost their last orders'.

o: Not asking a colleague to review the script
items.a: Not asking a colleague to review the script
items.e: 'If only I had asked a colleague to review the script first!'.

o: Nobody will use the test database
Changes to production will need a second person's approval
items.a: Changes to production will need a second person's approval
items.e: 'no one will touch the production database unless a second person approves'.

title: Testing in production
instructions: Leé el texto y elegí la respuesta correcta.
text: Some teams argue that if a system is not tested in real conditions, its problems will only appear when users arrive. That is why some companies run experiments with a small percentage of real users before a full launch. However, critics point out that this practice is acceptable only provided that failures cannot cause serious damage. A photo-sharing app, for example, might test a new button in production; a bank, on the other hand, would think twice unless it had a safe way to undo any change. If more companies had followed this cautious approach, several well-known outages might have been avoided.

items.q: According to critics, when is testing in production acceptable?
o: When failures cannot cause serious damage
When the company is very large
items.a: When failures cannot cause serious damage
items.e: 'acceptable only provided that failures cannot cause serious damage'.

items.q: What would a bank need before testing in production?
o: A safe way to undo any change
items.a: A safe way to undo any change
items.e: 'unless it had a safe way to undo any change'.
